not_say: **BAP1 and CDKN2A** — both are frequently altered in MPM [uncited] and represent a major therapeutic gap in the corpus. No papers capturing PRMT5 synthetic lethality from MTAP co-deletion (common in CDKN2A-deleted mesothelioma) showed up.
**No clinical outcome data**: The corpus is biochemistry/preclinical-biased. VT3989 clinical activity is noted qualitatively; no survival curves or OS data are captured.

**VEGF/anti-angiogenic targets, PDL1/checkpoint data**: The corpus doesn't have MPM-specific checkpoint data (bevacizumab + chemotherapy, nivolumab/ipilimumab combos are the standard-of-care [uncited] but aren't captured here).
**Mesothelin** — a major clinical target in MPM (antibody-drug conjugates, CAR-T) [uncited] — doesn't appear in this corpus at all.
quote: **NF2 (Merlin)** is inactivated in 30–40% of malignant pleural mesothelioma (MPM) cases (10.1111/jcmm.18330). When NF2 is lost, it can no longer relay contact-inhibition signals through the Hippo kinase cascade (MST1/2 → LATS1/2), so **YAP1 and TAZ (WWTR1)** accumulate in the nucleus and drive a TEAD1-4-dependent pro-proliferative transcriptional program (CYR61, CTGF as canonical readouts).
uncited_example: **Tumour-associated macrophages**: The macrophage review covers CD47–SIRPα, CSF1R, CD40, and VISTA as remodelling targets. Not MPM-specific in the corpus, but the heavily immunosuppressive TME of MPM [uncited] makes these generically relevant.
